name: Balanced Waypoints
description: Personal budgeting: accounts, a register, budgets, schedules and reports.

fields.label: Your email address
fields.help: Sign up with this email first and you become the administrator.

settings.label: Currency symbol
settings.help: Shown before amounts. A label only, with no conversion.

settings.label: Default time zone
settings.help: For people who have not picked one. Admin > Settings in Balanced overrides it.

settings.label: Close sign-up after the first account
settings.help: Other accounts are then created by an administrator.

settings.label: Mail server
settings.help: Together with "Send as", this makes Admin > Mail Server in Balanced read-only.

settings.label: Send as
settings.help: For example: Balanced Waypoints <noreply@example.com>. Needed with a mail server.

settings.label: Secure connection
settings.help: Leave on Automatic unless your mail server needs otherwise.

settings.label: Allow private-network addresses for mail and bank sync
settings.help: Leave off unless you run your own mail relay or SimpleFIN bridge on your network.

settings.label: Keep a copy of saved settings in the database
settings.help: For hosts that replace their disk on every deploy.

settings.label: Full database connection string
settings.help: For example mongodb+srv:// for Atlas. Leave empty to use the bundled database. When set, the bundled one is not used.

settings.label: Database version
settings.help: Only change this for a Raspberry Pi 4 or older. On an install that already has data, switching versions can stop the database from starting.

insideApp: The mail server and LDAP can also be set inside Balanced, under Admin. What is saved there takes priority, and a mail server set from the Gateway makes Admin > Mail Server read-only.
Each person connects their own bank sync inside Balanced.

storage.label: Database
storage.help: Your accounts, transactions and budgets. The most important one.

storage.label: Backups
storage.help: Backups. Best kept on a different disk from the database.

storage.label: Secrets
storage.help: The master key the app made for itself. Without it your data cannot be read, so keep it with your backups.

storage.label: Log files
storage.help: Records of what the app did.

postInstall: Open Balanced, choose sign up, and use the administrator email you entered.
